title: common
description: Shared definitions of the record schemas: every id grammar (DEC-227), the state classes (DEC-229) and the shared frontmatter (DEC-239). The record schemas refer to this file; none repeats an id pattern or the state classes.

ticket_id.description: A ticket id as tk writes it: a project prefix and four characters.

wbs_id.description: A work-breakdown id: the wave and a number, as in W1-08.

decision_id.description: A decision id: an ADR file (ADR-0002) or a register entry (DEC-012).

lesson_id.description: A lesson id: the letter L and four or more digits, as in L-0074 (DEC-252).

record_id.description: The id of any other record (failure, research record, gate or decision package, checkpoint): an upper-case prefix and a local part, as in FAIL-0001 or DP-8.

state_class.description: The state class of a record (CAP-07.b, DEC-229).

frontmatter.description: The frontmatter every record shares (CAP-50.a, DEC-239). The canonical path and content_hash are derived by gov and are not stored. Each record schema gives `id` its grammar.
